test_title: PYST 56: SSC GD Constable 2022 - Reasoning (Held On : 02 Feb 2023 Shift 4)
subject: reasoning
question: Six persons A, B, C, D, E and F are sitting in a row facing north. D sits at the right end of the row. F is sitting immediate left of D. Only B sits between A and F. Only E sits between C and A. Who is sitting immediate right of A?
solution:
Given: Six persons A, B, C, D, E and F are sitting in a row facing north.

1) D sits at the right end of the row.

2) F is sitting immediate left of D.

3) Only B sits between A and F.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/14093f2b5e56a00b5382aac8e88696e8a107163f6d7a70aa606625bfcc37de92.png] 

4) Only E sits between C and A.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/1abe1b46671295be274e2359baaf08555a85fc0517ab8ece14cd3456cbcf9bd5.png] 

Here, 'B' is sitting immediate right of A.

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option 3"**.
